q: Which department is the central purchasing agency for stationery on Indian Railways?
Stationery indents are normally placed by departments on the Stores Department on what basis?
Stationery indents received from departments are consolidated by whom before procurement?
Stationery held in depots is issued to indentors against what document?
Urgent stationery needs arising between annual indents are met through what kind of purchase?

options.A: Local or emergency purchase by the Stores Department

q: Annual stationery indents are framed on the basis of what?
Surplus stationery found in a depot should be dealt with how?

options.C: Reallocated, returned or disposed of per procedure

q: Stock verification of stationery depots is carried out how?
Controlled or accountable stationery items are issued under what arrangement?
Procurement of stationery follows which set of procedures?
Passenger card tickets were traditionally printed at which facility?
Blank passenger tickets are treated as which class of stores?
Who is personally accountable for blank ticket stock held at a station?
Ticket stock is supplied to stations in what kind of series?
Stations submit what document daily to account for tickets sold?
Obsolete or used ticket blocks are destroyed under what condition?

options.D: After the prescribed retention period, under supervision

q: Besides tickets, railway printing presses also print what?
Security arrangements in ticket printing mainly aim to prevent what?

options.B: Forgery and misuse of blank stock

q: Railway forms are standardised primarily to achieve what?
A department wanting to introduce a new form must obtain what?
Indents for printed forms are placed on the railway printing press through which department?
Money-value forms such as ticket and pass books are stocked how?
Issues of controlled forms to users are recorded in what?
Obsolete forms are dealt with how before destruction?

options.D: Withdrawn from use and accounted for

q: Periodic review of form stocks is done to achieve what?

options.A: Avoid accumulation of obsolete and surplus stock

q: Standard forms prescribed by the Railway Board are identified by what?
The main objective of prescribing standard forms is what?
Local non-standard forms may be used under what condition?

options.D: With specific sanction, where no standard form exists

q: Amendments to standard forms are issued by whom?
A department must discontinue a form when what happens?

options.B: It is superseded or withdrawn by competent authority

q: Drugs and medicines for railway hospitals are procured by which department?

options.C: Stores Department, on Medical Department indents

q: Indents for medicines are raised by whom?
Commonly used drugs are often bought through which arrangement for steady supply?
In emergencies, medical officers may purchase medicines locally within what?
Medicines must be purchased from which kind of sources?
Samples of drugs received are subjected to what before acceptance?
Substandard or rejected drugs are dealt with how?

options.A: Rejected, returned or replaced per procedure

q: Medical officers are guided in indenting by which list?

options.B: Formulary or approved list of drugs

q: Time-expired drugs in hospital stores are handled how?

options.C: Segregated and disposed of per procedure

q: Vaccines and sera needing cold storage are kept under what conditions?
Besides instruments and dressings, hospital stores include what?
Drugs in hospital stores are accounted for in what records?
Narcotic and poisonous drugs are stored under what arrangement?

options.C: Under lock with a separate register

q: At the zonal level, medical stores functioning is overseen by whom?

options.D: The head of the Medical Department

q: Surgical instruments are treated how before re-issue?
Stock verification of hospital drug stores includes what check?
Linen in railway hospitals is classified as which type of stores?
Indents for hospital equipment are processed through which department?
Medical stores depots maintain what stock levels for essential drugs?
Records of drugs issued to patients are maintained for what purpose?
